independenceNote: Robonine sells the SO-ARM102 kit ($389) built on STS3215 and STS3250 servos. Its founder, Nikita Bragin (branikita), reposted the same stall test on Hugging Face.

source.title: Robonine: Feetech STS3250 Smart Actuator: Evaluation of Accuracy, Torque and Backlash

rig.encoder: Digital dial indicator, 0.01 mm resolution, on an 86 mm lever

claims.source: Feetech datasheet <= 0.5 deg as quoted by Robonine; Feetech primary not verified (Robonine cites a Feetech document dated 2024-01-16, Edition A/0)

notes: Backlash 0.64 mm at 86 mm, atan(0.64/86) = 0.43 deg, at 12 V and 25 +/- 2 C. Stall: up to 48 kg.cm (4.71 Nm) for a split second, then about 25 kg.cm (2.45 Nm) sustained after the overload protection activated. The stall instrument is not stated, and the weights the article lists cannot reach 48 kg.cm.
